contract.title: Q0 replay gate + DELIVER fix cold-start review (commit bfa0898)
contract.goal: Review exact commit bfa0898 on branch codex/20260819-q0-replay-gate. Re-check the prior review (commit a81a165) REQUEST_CHANGES findings: (F1) Q0 execution provenance ambiguity must be closed by one-to-one action identity binding (commit 9b1b429 added action_id; verify an ordinary non-Q0 service can no longer satisfy a Q0 expected action, repeated same-signature actions are distinct, and aborted/redecided attempts cannot be back-filled); (F2) verifier verdict/errors/action identity and a boolean executed field for offline replay evidence; (F4) atomic apply with no partial mutation on invalid plan; (F5) adversarial replay tests (same packet across plans, repeated same-signature actions, deliver replay, WAIT replay). Also verify the NEW DELIVER fix (commit bfa0898): a DELIVER action must be rejected unless action.sat is the satellite currently holding the packet (no teleport), with regression test and no partial mutation on rejection; WAIT sat ownership validation; holding-queue integration conservation/FIFO/area; q0_replay_expected/q0_execution_audit consistency; snapshot_global read-only and state_version monotonicity; Q0 tiny DP prototype q0_tiny.py correctness boundaries. Return APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES with FACT/INFERENCE/UNVERIFIED, exact path/line evidence, concrete reproduction conditions, severity and open_items. Do not modify code.
